description: This file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project. It includes mechanisms for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and interacting with plugin shells.

classes.name: Utils::SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and manage security tokens, including checking Thunder security configuration.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Encapsulates a unit of work to be dispatched, either inheriting from Core::IDispatchType<void> or Core::IDispatch depending on compilation flags.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves the security token, checking if Thunder security is configured, and caches the token.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for writing curl response data into a string stream.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is enabled by querying a local REST API.

methods.name: getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Thunder plugin client with security token authentication.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Queries the state of a plugin service via its callsign.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by its callsign.
